pairs.evidence: lib/script/editPlan.ts:98 The edit-plan contract the engine must satisfy has edits, refusals and a summary but no unchanged list (and additionalProperties:false would reject one), while pipeline/RECALIBRATE-PROMPT.md:71 asks for `unchanged[]`; Version (versions.ts) carries no such field either, so a render the engine considered and left alone cannot be told apart from one it forgot.

techniques.evidence: lib/script/editPlan.ts:98 Refusals with a why and refuse-before-apply ordering (recalibrate.ts:312) are both in place, but 'explicitly unchanged is a verdict' is missing from the schema, the parser and Version.
lib/script/editPlan.ts:20 The revision engine returns a list of operations, not whole scripts; parseEditPlan rejects a malformed plan instead of repairing it.

lib/script/versions.ts:33 Closed note kinds: more-focus, less-focus, descope, move-earlier/later, and custom as the escape hatch. applyEdits re-checks connector seams after cuts and moves (chainBreaks, editPlan.ts:250).

lib/script/recalibrate.ts:97 Scope decisions outrank notes in both directions: GUARD 1 covers required cards, GUARD 2 (recalibrate.ts:295) covers descoped cards. Both run on the simulated path and the model path.
lib/script/editPlan.ts:312 A beat's seconds are split across its cards with the same function the baseline uses. Applied beats start from baseAttribution (line 179) and are amended, not re-derived.

lib/sound/generate.ts:197 Unknown modes and all-keep edits are refused by name before anything is rendered or paid for.
